dedupe_keys.name: electricity imports and exports per market including wheel through energy

description: Electricity imports and exports per market (including wheel-through energy) is a dataset listed in Hydro-Québec open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Hydro-Québec. Data on net electricity imports and exports per market. Updated hourly, the data illustrates variations associated with exports and imported electricity sources according to market and based on time of day. The data includes wheel-through energy, which represents only a small percentage of exchanges. Coverage: Québec (Hydro-Québec). The portal files it under Electricity consumption. The portal shows 48 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-donnees-hydroquebec-com-portal.
